AAI Junior Executive & Manager Online Form 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Airports Authority of India (AAI) has released the notification for the post of Junior Executive, Manager. This recruitment has been issued for 389 posts. The online application process for AAI Junior Executive & Manager Recruitment 2026 has started on 08 August 2026, and candidates can apply till 07 September 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for AAI Junior Executive & Manager Recruitment 2026, which are given below..

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 08 August 2026
  • Last Date : 07 September 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 07 September 2026
  • Exam Date : Notify Later
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 1000/-
  • SC, ST : 0/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
